title: Improving Generalization on Cybersecurity Tasks with Multi-Modal Contrastive Learning

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What if your cybersecurity AI could learn from videos, text, and logs all at once?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Cyberattacks are evolving faster than models can keep up — generalization is failing.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Multi-modal contrastive learning trains AI on diverse data to spot threats it's never seen before.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: It uses visual and textual clues together to create stronger, more adaptable security models.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This impacts everything from banks to hospitals — protecting systems that can't afford mistakes.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key is teaching AI to recognize patterns across different data types, not just one.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Have you ever wondered how AI could learn from both code and videos to stop new threats?
